sn44.7:1.1: atha kho vacchagotto paribbājako yenāyasmā mahāmoggallāno tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā mahāmoggallānena saddhiṃ sammodi
sn44.7:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho vacchagotto paribbājako āyasmantaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ etadavoca
sn44.7:2.1: kiṃ nu kho bho moggallāna sassato lokoti.
sn44.7:2.4: kiṃ panāvuso bho moggallāna asassato lokoti.
sn44.7:2.7: kiṃ nu kho bho moggallāna antavā lokoti.
sn44.7:2.10: kiṃ pana bho moggallāna anantavā lokoti.
sn44.7:2.13: kiṃ nu kho bho moggallāna taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti.
sn44.7:2.16: kiṃ pana bho moggallāna aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti.
sn44.7:2.19: kiṃ pana bho moggallāna hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.7:2.22: kiṃ pana bho moggallāna na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.7:2.25: kiṃ nu kho bho moggallāna hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.7:2.27: hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.7:2.28: kiṃ pana bho moggallāna neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.7:2.30: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti.
sn44.7:3.1: ko nu kho bho moggallāna hetu ko paccayo yena aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ puṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ hoti
sn44.7:3.2: sassato lokoti vā asassato lokoti vā antavā lokoti vā anantavā lokoti vā taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīranti vā aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīranti vā hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā.
sn44.7:3.3: ko pana bho moggallāna hetu ko paccayo yena samaṇassa gotamassa evaṃ puṭṭhassa na evaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ hoti
sn44.7:3.4: sassato lokotipi asassato lokotipi antavā lokotipi anantavā lokotipi taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīrantipi aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīrantipi hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipi na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipi hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipi neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipīti.
sn44.7:4.1: aññatitthiyā ca kho vaccha paribbājakā cakkhuṃ etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti samanupassanti …pe…
sn44.7:4.2: jivhaṃ etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti samanupassanti …pe…
sn44.7:4.3: manaṃ etaṃ mama esohamasmi eso me attāti samanupassanti.
sn44.7:4.4: tasmā aññatitthiyānaṃ paribbājakānaṃ evaṃ puṭṭhānaṃ evaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ hoti
sn44.7:4.6: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇāti vā.
sn44.7:4.7: tathāgato ca kho vaccha arahaṃ sammāsambuddho cakkhuṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassati …pe…
sn44.7:4.8: jivhaṃ netaṃ mama nesohamasmi na meso attāti samanupassati …pe…

sn44.7:4.12: neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇātipīti.

sn44.7:8.1: acchariyaṃ bho gotama abbhutaṃ bho gotama
sn44.7:8.2: yatra hi nāma satthu ca sāvakassa ca atthena attho byañjanena byañjanaṃ saṃsandissati samessati na vihāyissati yadidaṃ aggapadasmiṃ.
sn44.7:8.3: idānāhaṃ bho gotama samaṇaṃ mahāmoggallānaṃ upasaṅkamitvā etamatthaṃ apucchiṃ
sn44.7:8.4: samaṇopi me mahāmoggallāno etehi padehi etehi byañjanehi etamatthaṃ byākāsi seyyathāpi bhavaṃ gotamo.
